data.source: results/s1_twins (main eed9b36; GBM bcat via scripts/s1_ingest.py)

statistic: M2: max over grid of multi-band cross-correlation with free per-band scale (s1_deform.rho_free), |dk| <= 2
threshold_basis: calibration half (split seed 1), per-pair FAR 1e-4 of 185,392 real pairs
refinement: ln s in +-0.03 step 0.002 around the best grid value, lag re-selected
consistency: per-band chi2 p at the refined stretch (calibrated score, not an exact probability)
dedup: connected components of candidate pairs sharing a burst
expected_false_candidates: about FAR x pairs x 0.024 (unrelated pass rate 48/2000) ~ 1.8 -> exploratory search
data_used_for_tuning: calibration half: thresholds, unrelated pass rate; hold-out half: seen with M0/M1/M2 and the fine grid (#167)
